records.name: Six-terminal balanced winding motor
records.function: Six accessible winding terminals for star/delta connection analysis.
records.simulationNotes: Connection and current derive from circuit wires and closed contacts. Fixed balanced impedance remains the default. Optional T-equivalent mode requires explicit motor parameters. Optional first-order rotor-speed steps additionally require this mode, positive user-entered inertia, and non-negative user-entered load torque. This educational model uses 10 ms steps and does not model flux, multi-mass mechanics, saturation, harmonics, or certified relay curves.
records.status: engineering profile; no manufacturer order code

records.name: Power conductor junction

references: IEC 60617 — conductors and connecting devices (diagram reference)

records.status: engineering profile; no manufacturer order code
